task.name: Root finding: Two-Dimensional Systems
task.description: Write a Python find_root_system(F, x0) function that returns a point in R^2 with residual norm at most 1e-8 within 500 function evaluations; scored by the fraction of three fixed local test systems solved, discounted by the mean number of evaluations used (higher is better).
task.contract: find_root_system(F, x0) -> x in R^2 with ||F(x)|| <= 1e-8, at most 500 evaluations. Score: success rate discounted by evaluations used
